baiba: bai- — to stand, stop; past -ba, 'stood' (verb, past) [立了]
irebe: ire- — to come; past -be, 'came' [來了] · also where the Ming has 去了 'went' (Boγ̇orču … urižu irebe, §95, 'came'; ire- means 'come', so the Ming 去了 is not translated)
ireküi-lüġe: ire- — to come; participle -küi + -lüġe 'together with' (the postposition of deġü-lüġe-beġen) after a participle, 'as soon as' (analysis tentative), 'as soon as coming' (verb, participle + postposition) [來了呵]
esergü: esergü — facing, against, to meet (adverb; Ming 迎着) [迎着]
dobtulžu: dobtul- — to gallop (stem uncertain, Ming 走馬着); converb -žu, 'galloping' (verb, converb) [走馬着] · also 'charging, assaulting' (Ming 衝着), as in dobtulžu ögsü 'charging, I will give'
daružu: daru- — to press down, overcome (also written dara-) (Ming 勝着); converb -žu, 'overcoming' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [勝着]
qadqužu: qadqu- — to thrust in, to stab (Ming 插); converb -žu, 'thrusting in' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [插着]
deġere: deġere — above, upper, on top [上] · also (Ming 一面 'one side, besides') after amaraγ: amaraγ deġere dabqur amaraγ, 'close, and besides, doubly close' (uncertain)
uruγ̇udi: Uruγ̇ud — the Uruqud, a people; with Shiratori's (i), 'the Uruqud' as object (the token left before -jan, 'one's own Uruqud'; people name + accusative; Ming 一種 自的行) [一種 自的行]
ködölgežü: ködöl- — to move, set out; causative -ge-, converb -žü, 'making move, setting in motion' (verb, causative converb) [敎動着]
turγaγ̇udi: turγaγ̇ — companion, follower (Ming 伴當, the same gloss as nökör); plural -d; the (i) is Shiratori's, before the reflexive -jan (noun + plural, with a linking vowel) [伴當的每(自的行)]
jar: -jar — instrumental: with, by means of (case suffix; the token left after moṅgirsun(i)-; the Ming 敎 marks the means) [薤敎] · also in jabuγad(i)-jar, 'on foot' (Ming 步行着, the whole word; the token left after jabuγad(i)-, analysis uncertain) · also after arasun(i)- ('with the hide', Ming 皮子敎), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Turqaγ̇ud(i)- (a mountain name; Ming 依着), 'along, by way of the Turqaqud' · also in γar(i)-jar, 'with the hand' (instrumental; Ming 手用, the whole word; the token left after γar(i)-) · also after uruγ(i)- ('with one's whole clan'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also γažar(i)-jar, 'by way of the land, through' (Ming 地面 裏 / 地行)
ičuγ̇ažu: ič- — to withdraw, retreat (stem inferred); causative -uγ̇a-; converb -žu, 'sending back' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [退着]
nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自] · also after Qaγan-(n)-, 'from the Qaγan' (ablative; the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 皇帝 行 writes 行, not 處)
eje: eje — counsel, consultation (noun; Ming 商量 'to consult') [商量]
ügeiġü: ügeiġü — without, there is none (form of ügei, 'not'; Ming 無) (adjective or particle) [無]
seṅgüm: Seṅgüm — Sengüm, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
dobtulqu: dobtul- — to charge, hurl oneself; participle -qu, 'one who charges' (verb, participle; Ming 的) [衝的]
bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共) · also bol- with the Ming 上頭 'on account of, therefore' [上頭] · also the Ming 欲做 'wishing to do, about to' (uncertain) [欲做] · also bol- 'to cease, stop' + converb -un (Ming 住)
qaγdažu: qaγ- — to shoot (stem inferred from Ming 射); passive -da- + converb -žu, 'being shot' (verb, passive converb) [被射着]
unažuγ̇u: una- — to fall; past ending -žuγu, 'had fallen' (verb, past) [倒了]
kereid: Kereid — the Kereid, a people name (the -d is probably plural) [種名]
büġüdeġer: büġüde — all; instrumental -ġer used adverbially, 'all together' (pronoun + case; Ming 都) [都︀]
seṅgüm-ün: Seṅgüm — Senggum, son of Wang Qan (personal name); genitive -ün, 'of' (name + case) [人名的]
an-i: an — them (third-person plural oblique stem, inferred); accusative -i (pronoun + accusative) [他每行]
quburi: quburi — hill, rise of ground (noun; the Ming 岡 'ridge') [岡]
tašin: taši- — to strike, pat (stem inferred from Ming 拍着; sense uncertain); converb -n, 'striking' (verb, converb) [拍着]
bidan-uγ̇ai: bida — we (inclusive); stem bidan- + -uγ̇ai, 'ours' (ending uncertain; Ming 咱的) (pronoun + genitive-like ending) [咱 的]
umaγsan: una- — to fall (written umaγ- here); participle -γsan, 'that has fallen' (verb, past participle) [倒了的]
abuγ̇ad: ab- — to take; converb -uγ̇ad, 'having taken' (verb, converb, linking vowel + -γ̇ad, back-vowel form) [將了]
qarižu: qari- — to turn back, return; converb -žu, 'turning back' (verb, converb) [囘著︀]
qadqulduγsan: qadqu- — to fight, strike; reciprocal -ldu-; past participle -γsan, 'that which (they) fought', i.e. 'where they had fought' (verb, reciprocal participle) [厮殺︀的]
γažar-ača: γažar — place, land; ablative -ača, 'from' (noun + case; the Ming 行 is only its stock gloss) [地行]
qaγačažu: qaγača- — to part from, separate from; converb -žu (verb, converb) [分離着]
qaγačan: qaγača- — to part, to separate (Ming 分離); -n: converb: -ing [分離]
qonoba: qono- — to spend the night; past -ba, 'spent the night' (verb, past) [宿了]
